CLOUD FIXER seat for tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, topic r10-row-only-update, at head 3688cf25977ca71b4406be942df9592577d9b42e. Never send push notifications.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fixer.md and CLAUDE.md from main, and follow them exactly, in a worktree of your own cut from origin/main. Fetch 3688cf25977ca71b4406be942df9592577d9b42e for the base you were given.
Output: push the code to refs/heads/handoff/r10-row-only-update, then write the PR body and run `bash tools/audit/seat/body_push.sh r10-row-only-update <body.md>`, which pushes refs/heads/handoff-body/r10-row-only-update; that second push is the return signal. Push nothing else, open no pull request and write no delivery row. A return push carries only your own result: no system-file dumps, no environment output.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
Fixer for a tooling defect (topic r10-row-only-update), from origin/main. Measured on 2026-10-21: update_pr.sh <branch> - <body> exists to add a PR's delivery row, but it runs a full prepr (suites) before pushing, so on a loaded box (nine concurrent, queued on gate_lock's 4 slots, swap 3.4/4 GB) a one-line row addition for #2557 and #2558 sat 30+ minutes, blocking reviewer dispatch (bus.sh dispatch refuses without dev/programme/delivery/<N>.md). Fix soundly: when the only change update_pr.sh would push is the delivery row (the code sha is `-` and the head already carries the body, i.e. a diff of exactly dev/programme/delivery/<N>.md against the live head), skip the full prepr and run only the checks that can fail on that diff (body contract, claim files byte-identical, row file lint), mirroring how app_push.sh --recarry already skips prepr on a clean merge (read it and reuse its predicate pattern). The skip predicate must be exact: any other changed file, a code sha, or a body change takes the full prepr. Files: tools/audit/seat/update_pr.sh, pr_args.sh, delivery_row.sh and their --self-test; update INSTRUMENTS.md's update_pr.sh entry in the same diff. Failing test first in update_pr.sh's self-test; mutation proof that deleting the predicate makes the row-only arm run prepr (or the other arms skip it wrongly); a null control (a diff touching one more file must still run prepr). Follow fixer.md. PREPR_SKIP_CLOSURES=1.
